item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Replace destructive timeout with a privacy lock","mechanism":"After inactivity, hide the session while retaining selections locally, rather than clearing the visitor's work.","implementation":"At 90 seconds, replace all content with a neutral locked screen; stop speech and clear navigation previews. Resume requires the session code.","check":"Leave distinctive selections idle: verify they disappear at timeout, remain inaccessible through Back, and return intact after authorized resume.","risk":"A visitor change before timeout can still expose visible selections."},{"action":"Provide an anonymous session recovery code","mechanism":"A temporary secret lets returning visitors recover work without accounts or identifying information.","implementation":"Before ticket selection, let visitors create and verify a masked session code. Rate-limit failed unlocks; reveal neither selections nor code hints.","check":"Test recovery using touch, physical controls, and screen reader; wrong codes must never reveal session contents or existence.","risk":"Forgotten codes require restarting; observers may capture code entry."},{"action":"Offer explicit reading-time extensions","mechanism":"A non-destructive warning distinguishes continued reading from inactivity without treating screen-reader playback as visitor presence.","implementation":"Before locking, offer a large 'Keep reading' control, also activated by physical Confirm. Preserve reading position; offer a longer timeout with an exposure warning.","check":"Compare default and extended timeouts: measure reading interruptions, reconstruction attempts, and seconds selections remain visible after scripted abandonment.","risk":"Longer visible intervals increase exposure; extensions must never confirm purchases."},{"action":"Make starting fresh an isolated path","mechanism":"A neutral entry screen opens an empty session without exposing or resuming the previous visitor's work.","implementation":"Provide 'Start new visit' on the lock screen and an always-visible 'Finish and hide' control. Separate carts, history, speech queues, and form caches.","check":"Start a new visit after abandonment; exercise Back, Confirm, screen reader, and payment entry. No previous values should appear.","risk":"Hidden recoverable sessions need bounded storage and an explicit expiry policy."},{"action":"Collect personal details only at checkout","mechanism":"Keeping identifying information out of browsing reduces what abandonment can expose or require retaining.","implementation":"Defer required personal fields until checkout. On lock, discard those fields while preserving ticket selections; require re-entry after resume and suppress spoken summaries.","check":"Abandon at every checkout field, then resume or start fresh. Verify ticket recovery without personal-field recovery, autofill, or audible disclosure.","risk":"Visitors interrupted during checkout must re-enter details, though not tickets."},{"action":"Keep recovery and confirmation independent of connectivity","mechanism":"Local session storage supports offline reading and recovery; an explicit confirmation remains the sole purchase authorization.","implementation":"Store encrypted drafts locally with a disclosed expiry exceeding ten minutes. Never queue unconfirmed purchases; disable final confirmation offline if authorization requires connectivity.","check":"Disconnect for ten minutes, lock and recover selections, then reconnect. Verify no purchase occurs without explicit confirmation and retries cannot duplicate it.","risk":"Offline purchase completion depends on payment capability; draft preservation does not guarantee ticket issuance."}],"abstention_reason":""}
